(3) The scene shifts to a different part of the course where the woman is putting on a green with a blue flag visible, then cuts back to several more driving shots where her outfits change to a beige sleeveless top with a white skirt and later a green-and-white striped polo with a green pleated skirt, all set against a backdrop of distant forested mountains and perfectly manicured grass. (4) The final shots feature the woman in her green-and-white outfit executing a powerful swing on a high-elevation tee box overlooking a valley with a golf cart path and mountain ranges, with the natural sunlight casting soft shadows across the vibrant green landscape.
